title.zh: 灵巧手重定向 01｜换一只手，究竟保留什么？
title.en: Dexterous Retargeting 01 · What Survives a Change of Body?

summary.zh: 从相机观测、坐标系和机器人运动学，建立理解全部重定向路线的基础。
summary.en: From camera observations and coordinate frames to robot kinematics, objectives and execution.

title.zh: 同一个意图，不同的人手与机器人

text.zh: 试着用拇指和食指捏住一个小物体。机器人即使复制了关节角，指尖之间仍然可能留着缝。它也可能对齐两个指尖，却让其余手指穿进物体。重定向要决定：换了身体以后，哪些关系必须保留下来。这套课程沿着人手测量、机器人几何、接触、控制和评估，讲清整条链路。比较方法时，我们看它保留什么、需要什么，以及实验究竟证明了什么。
text.en: Close your thumb and index finger around a small object. A robot can copy the finger angles and still leave a gap. It can also match two fingertip positions while placing the remaining fingers through the object. Retargeting decides what should survive this change of body. This course follows the complete chain: measured human motion, robot geometry, contact, control, and evaluation. We will compare methods by what they preserve, what they require, and what their experiments actually establish.

title.zh: 先把整条遥操作链路拆开

text.zh: 摄像头提供的是图像，不是机器人指令。感知系统估计人手关键点、手腕位姿，或者拟合一个人手模型。标定把这些估计变换到机器人使用的坐标系中。重定向器输出机器人的关节目标，或者一条参考轨迹。控制器再通过电机和真实接触，尝试执行这条参考。因此，跟踪失败、映射失败和控制失败，需要分别诊断。把整条链路都叫作逆运动学，会掩盖真正需要改进的环节。
text.en: The camera provides images, not robot commands. A perception system estimates human landmarks, wrist pose, or a fitted hand model. Calibration expresses those estimates in the frames used by the robot. The retargeter produces robot joint targets or a reference trajectory. A controller then tries to realize that reference through motors and physical contact. Tracking failure, mapping failure, and control failure therefore need separate diagnoses. Calling the entire chain inverse kinematics hides the very distinctions needed to improve it.

title.zh: 点云、关键点和 Mesh，分别提供什么
title.en: What does a captured hand contain?

text.zh: 点云采样可见表面，所以手指背面可能根本没有被观测到。Mesh 将表面顶点连接起来，便于计算表面距离或检测碰撞。骨架更紧凑：关键点和关节层级描述手指如何运动。拟合模型能借助先验补全遮挡部分，但补全并不等于直接测量。重定向器必须知道：哪些量来自观测，哪些来自推断，哪些没有信息。增加表面顶点数量，并不自动意味着机器人动作会更准确。
text.en: A point cloud samples visible surfaces, so the back of a finger may be missing. A mesh connects surface vertices and makes surface distance or collision queries possible. A skeleton is smaller: landmarks and a joint hierarchy describe articulation. A fitted model can fill occluded regions using prior assumptions, but completion is not direct measurement. The retargeter must know which quantities are observed, inferred, or unavailable. More surface vertices do not automatically make the final robot movement more accurate.

title.zh: 机器人的自由度，不等于人手关键点数
title.en: The robot has its own coordinates

text.zh: 人手跟踪器可能输出二十一个关键点，机器人却接受更少的关节指令。这些关键点并不是二十一个能够独立驱动的关节。有的机器人关节存在机械耦合，手指长度和运动能力也可能不同。用 q 表示机器人独立关节变量。模型先按照耦合关系展开这些变量，再计算各连杆的位姿。如果把画面中每个关节都独立优化，可能得到硬件根本执行不了的姿态。
text.en: A human tracker may output twenty-one landmarks, while a robot accepts a smaller set of joint commands. Those landmarks are not twenty-one independently actuated joints. Some robot joints are mechanically coupled, and some fingers have different lengths or missing motions. Let q denote the independent robot joint variables. A model expands those variables through the couplings before computing the link poses. Optimizing every displayed joint independently can produce a configuration the hardware cannot execute.

title.zh: 正运动学：从关节角计算几何关系
title.en: Forward kinematics is the measuring tool

text.zh: 正运动学回答一个直接的问题：给定 q，机器人上的某个点会到哪里？每个关节贡献一个变换，这些变换沿运动链逐级组合。改变根部关节会带动所有下游连杆，改变末端关节只影响较小范围。我们把指尖位置写成 f(q)。目标函数再把这个计算结果与目标位置，或另一种几何关系进行比较。所以，机器人模型、关节顺序和单位，本身就是算法的一部分。
text.en: Forward kinematics answers a direct question: where does a robot point go for a given q? Each joint contributes a transformation, and transformations compose along the chain. Changing a base joint moves every downstream link; changing a distal joint affects a smaller region. Write a fingertip position as f of q. An objective compares that computed position with a target or another geometric relationship. This is why the robot model, joint order, and units are part of the algorithm.

title.zh: 逆运动学：找一个尽量满足要求的解
title.en: Inverse kinematics is a constrained search

text.zh: 逆运动学反过来问：哪个 q 能让指尖接近指定位置？多个解可能到达同一个点，也有些目标根本不存在精确解。关节限位把搜索限制在允许的区间内。附加惩罚可以偏好舒适姿态，或者偏好相邻帧之间较小的变化。求解器在这些约束内选择一个折中。最终损失较低，只说明选定的数学目标得到了较好的匹配。它不能保证抓取稳定，更不能保证操作任务成功。
text.en: Inverse kinematics reverses the question: which q places the tip near the requested position? Several solutions may reach the same point, while some targets have no exact solution. A joint limit restricts the search to a permitted interval. Additional penalties can prefer a comfortable posture or a small change from the previous frame. The solver selects a compromise inside these constraints. A low final loss only means the selected mathematical objective was matched well. It does not certify a stable grasp or successful manipulation.

title.zh: 坐标系错了，方向正确也会映射错
title.en: Frames can change the meaning of a vector

text.zh: 想象操作者保持捏合，同时转动整个手腕。在相机坐标系中，指尖坐标变化了，但手指的局部姿态可能基本不变。减去手腕位置可以消除平移，却不能消除手腕旋转。若要把点表示在手腕坐标系中，还必须应用手腕旋转的逆变换。比较向量以前，机器人一侧也必须使用一致的约定。要检查左右手约定、坐标轴顺序、米与毫米，以及每个变换的方向。
text.en: Imagine the same pinch while the operator rotates the entire wrist. In the camera frame, fingertip coordinates change even though the local finger posture stays similar. Subtracting the wrist position removes translation, but it does not remove wrist rotation. To express points in the wrist frame, also apply the inverse wrist rotation. The same convention must be used on the robot side before comparing vectors. Check handedness, axis order, meters versus millimeters, and the direction of every transform.

title.zh: 手腕负责位置，手指负责形状，但二者会耦合
title.en: Wrist motion and finger shape are different jobs

text.zh: 手指重定向与手腕重定向，需要不同的参考。手腕决定位于物体附近的手掌位置和朝向。手指决定手内部的关节构型。分开映射更容易调试，但接触会把两部分的解耦合起来。略微移动手腕，可能让较短的机器人拇指到达人手示范的接触位置。如果一种方法优化了这种手腕自由度，对比基线也必须获得相同的自由度。否则，实验同时改变了方法和问题本身。
text.en: Finger retargeting and wrist retargeting need different references. The wrist determines the hand location and orientation relative to the object. The fingers determine the internal hand configuration. Mapping them separately makes debugging easier, but contact can couple their solutions. A slightly shifted wrist may allow a short robot thumb to reach a demonstrated contact. If a method optimizes that wrist freedom, compare it with baselines given the same freedom. Otherwise, the experiment changes both the method and the problem.

title.zh: 到底要保留角度、位置，还是接触关系

text.zh: 直接关节映射保留选定的角度关系。位置匹配保留指定坐标系中的若干点。向量匹配保留选定点对之间的相对方向和长度。距离匹配只保留长度，因此方向仍然可能存在歧义。接触感知匹配则关心：手的哪些部位应该与物体的哪些部位接触。这些是不同的相似性定义，不同定义会产生不同的机器人行为。
text.en: Direct joint mapping preserves selected angular relationships. Position matching preserves selected points in a chosen coordinate frame. Vector matching preserves relative directions and lengths between selected pairs of points. Distance matching preserves lengths alone, so orientation can remain ambiguous. Contact-aware matching instead asks which parts of the hand should meet which parts of the object. These are different definitions of similarity, and different definitions lead to different robot behavior.

title.zh: 缩放能对齐尺寸，却无法消除形态差异

text.zh: 假设我们用同一个缩放系数，乘上所有人手目标向量。这可能补偿整体手掌尺寸差异。它却无法分别修正拇指位置、手指比例、关节轴，以及缺少的自由度。参与捏取的手指可能需要更小的间距，其他手指却需要保留张开的程度。这正是选择性投影、差异权重、学习映射或物体相对约束的动机。每一种选择都会引入假设，都需要在目标动作上检验。
text.en: Suppose we multiply every human target vector by one scale factor. This may compensate for overall hand size. It cannot independently fix thumb placement, finger proportions, joint axes, and missing degrees of freedom. The pinching fingers may need a smaller separation while the other fingers preserve their spread. This motivates selective projection, different weights, learned maps, or object-relative constraints. Each option introduces an assumption that must be tested on its intended motions.

title.zh: 精度、平滑和延迟，需要一起看

text.zh: 指尖估计中的噪声，会让机器人的目标在相邻帧之间跳动。时间正则可以减小跳动，但过强的平滑也可能延迟有意动作。更快的重定向器，也无法直接恢复所有相机都看不到的指尖。应分别测量采集、估计、映射、传输和电机响应。还要测量完整链路的端到端延迟及其波动。在纯摄像头遥操作中，可见性和可靠的手腕估计，可能比求解速度更早成为瓶颈。
text.en: A noisy fingertip estimate can make the robot target jump between neighboring frames. Temporal regularization can reduce those jumps, but strong smoothing may delay intentional motion. A faster retargeter does not recover a fingertip hidden from every camera. Measure capture, estimation, mapping, transport, and motor response separately. Then measure the complete end-to-end delay and its variation. For camera-only teleoperation, visibility and reliable wrist estimation may dominate before solver speed does.

title.zh: 只优化真正可控的关节

text.zh: 选择损失之前，先确定哪些机器人关节能够独立运动。有些末端关节会通过机械联动跟随另一个关节。它的角度等于源关节角乘比例，再加固定偏移。优化器计算指尖位置时，就应该遵守这种关系。先自由优化两个关节、执行时再覆盖其中一个，会破坏预测几何。关节限位约束搜索范围，关节名称决定控制命令的顺序。这两种映射只要出错，再像样的动画也可能是错的。
text.en: Before choosing a loss, define which robot variables can actually move independently. Some distal joints follow another joint through a mechanical coupling. Their angle is a scaled source angle plus a fixed offset. The optimizer should respect that relationship while computing fingertip positions. Optimizing both freely and overriding one afterward invalidates the predicted geometry. Joint limits constrain the search, while joint names determine command ordering. A convincing animation can still be wrong if either mapping is incorrect.

title.en: Position IK asks where, not how

text.zh: 位置逆运动学换了一个问题：机器人各指尖应该去哪里？给定候选关节配置，正向运动学就能算出这些位置。目标函数累加预测指尖与目标指尖之间的加权误差。姿态惩罚可以在相近解中优先选择更自然的配置。时间惩罚则抑制相邻帧之间过大的关节变化。然而，同一个指尖位置可以对应不同的中间指节姿态。一种姿态绕开杯子，另一种却可能弯进杯子里。

title.zh: 向量比距离多保留什么

text.zh: 距离告诉我们两个关键点相隔多远。但它不能告诉我们连接两个关键点的方向。单位方向保留朝向，却主动去掉长度信息。完整向量在统一人机坐标轴后，同时保留长度和方向。两个位置相减可以抵消平移，但不能抵消旋转。所以，即使使用相对向量，坐标系约定仍必须一致。应该根据要保留的几何关系，选择具体表示。
text.en: A distance tells us how far apart two landmarks are. It cannot tell us which direction connects those two landmarks. A unit direction provides direction, but deliberately removes the length. A full vector preserves both, after the human and robot axes are aligned. Subtracting two positions cancels translation; it does not cancel rotation. This is why relative vectors still need consistent coordinate conventions. Choose the representation according to the relationship you need to preserve.

text.zh: 多种方法都使用SLSQP，但这并不意味着行为相同。目标函数定义什么配置更好，求解器负责寻找这种配置。暖启动用上一帧结果作为搜索起点。时间惩罚直接改变目标函数，抑制过快变化。输出滤波则在优化之后修改命令，并可能增加延迟。比较各方法时，关节限位和机械联动约束必须保持一致。否则，看似来自损失的变化，实际可能来自其他模块。

text.zh: 先横向移动食指，再在靠近掌心的位置重复这个动作。机器人应响应可预测，不该突然迟钝或过度敏感。因此，学习式重定向需要的不只是一张看起来相似的手势。它要在你实际会做的动作范围内，建立有效映射。这一章，我们沿着三种方法，拆开这个映射如何被学会。关键是监督信号从哪里来，以及哪些问题仍在网络之外。
text.en: Move your index finger sideways, then try the same movement near your palm. The robot should respond predictably, without suddenly becoming stiff or oversensitive. A learned retargeter therefore needs more than one convincing hand pose. It needs a useful mapping across the motions you actually perform. In this chapter, we follow three approaches to learning that mapping. The key questions are where supervision comes from, and what remains outside the network.

text.zh: 在线优化器拿到人手姿态后，现场搜索合适的机器人关节角。神经网络重定向则把大量计算工作，提前放到了训练阶段。部署时，已经学好的参数把新输入变成一次直接预测。这叫摊销：前期计算被后面大量查询共同分担。优化目标仍然重要，因为它决定网络会偏好什么样的解。快速预测也可能违反那些只在训练中被软性鼓励的约束。
text.en: An online optimizer starts with a human pose and searches for suitable robot joints. A neural retargeter performs most of that computational work during training instead. At deployment, its learned weights turn a new input into an immediate prediction. This is amortization: earlier computation is shared across many later queries. The optimization objective still matters, because it defines what the network learns to prefer. Fast predictions can still violate constraints that training only softly encourages.

text.zh: 训练图像提供人手姿态，却没有唯一对应的机器人姿态。Robotic Telekinesis 用几何能量评价每个预测出的构型。考虑两种手的尺寸差异后，关键点之间的相对向量应尽量一致。可微正向运动学把机器人关节角连接到这些几何关系。梯度再告诉网络，下一次更新怎样降低这个能量。没有配对机器人标签，不等于没有监督；监督来自设计好的目标。

text.zh: 对每根手指，一个小型神经网络把人体指尖坐标映射成机器人关节位置。训练时，正向运动学再把这些关节角变回机器人指尖坐标。几何损失就在这些可比较的位置和相互关系上计算。损失的梯度穿过机器人模型，反向调整网络权重。推理时，映射器直接预测关节角，不再重复整个训练循环。新的目标手需要相应模型和训练，而不只是给输出关节改名。

text.zh: 这张原论文示意图，把 GeoRT 的两个目标分得很清楚。运动保持关心：人体的小幅移动，是否让机器人沿一致方向移动。空间覆盖关心：映射实际利用了多少机器人指尖工作空间。一个映射可能保持方向，却把所有手势都压缩在很小的区域里。反过来，输出分布很广、覆盖充分，也可能让响应难以预测。同时优化这两个目标，才能显式处理这种权衡，而不是认为看起来相似就足够。
text.en: Two GeoRT objectives answer different questions, as this original illustration makes clear. Motion preservation asks whether small human movements produce consistent robot directions. Coverage asks how much of the robot fingertip workspace the mapping actually uses. A mapper can preserve direction while compressing every gesture into a tiny region. Conversely, widely distributed outputs can cover space while responding unpredictably. Optimizing both exposes this tradeoff rather than assuming that visual similarity already solves it.

title.zh: 把接触描述固定在物体上

text.zh: 首先，想象在杯子的侧面画一个小点。杯子在桌面上移动时，这个点的世界坐标会变化。但在刚体运动中，它相对杯子的位置始终不变。物体坐标系让我们能在这片移动表面上描述接触。先减去物体平移，再消除它的旋转，就得到点的局部坐标。再应用当前物体位姿，就能把这个局部目标放回场景。这种表示的可靠性，取决于物体位姿估计是否准确。
text.en: First, imagine painting a small dot on the side of that cup. As the cup moves across the table, the dot changes its world position. Its position relative to the cup stays the same throughout the rigid motion. An object coordinate frame lets us describe contact on that moving surface. Subtract the object translation, then undo its rotation to express a world point locally. Apply the current object pose to move that local target back into the scene. This only works when the estimated object pose is reliable.

text.zh: 优化器使用接触标签之前，必须先定义什么算接触。常见的几何规则是：手部点到物体表面的距离足够小，就标为接触。但距离阈值是建模选择，不是接触力的测量值。网格噪声可能制造假接触，缺失表面也可能掩盖真实接触。需要记录标签来自标注、重建几何、仿真，还是物理传感器。对于这个杯子，还要问：手指的哪个区域，接触物体的哪个部分？这层对应关系，比一个简单的接触或未接触标志更有信息。
text.en: A contact label usually needs a definition before an optimizer can use it. A common geometric rule marks a hand point as touching when surface distance is small. But a threshold is a modeling choice, not a measurement of contact force. Noisy meshes can create false contact; missing surfaces can hide real contact. Record whether labels came from annotation, reconstructed geometry, simulation, or physical sensors. For our cup, also ask which finger region touches which part of the object. That correspondence matters more than a single yes-or-no contact flag.

text.zh: Kinematic Motion Retargeting 从准确的手物网格和一段动作序列开始。这张原始总览图还要求提供手部或物体上的稠密接触标注。目标手需要骨架驱动的网格，以及人工指定的表面对应关系。其中包括用于标识对应区域的虚拟标记点和轴向曲线。方法先迁移接触区域，再估计并细化轨迹，最后拟合平滑样条。输出是一条运动学轨迹；此时还没有求解接触力。
text.en: Kinematic Motion Retargeting starts with accurate hand and object meshes and a motion sequence. Its original overview also requires dense contact annotations on the hand or object. The target hand needs a skeleton-driven mesh and manually specified surface correspondences. These include virtual markers and axial curves that identify matching regions. The method transfers contact areas, estimates a trajectory, refines it, then fits smooth splines. The output is a kinematic trajectory; it does not yet solve contact forces.

text.zh: TopoRetarget 走另一条路线：保留连接手和物体的局部图结构。在总览图中，骨骼方向首先给出机器人手的初始构型。人手关键点和物体表面采样点，成为交互网格中的顶点。机器人使用对应顶点，并沿用同一套图连接关系进行比较。对于杯子，手指现在同时受到附近物体点和手部结构的约束。目标函数关注这些关系，而不是逐个精确复制所有全局点坐标。
text.en: TopoRetarget takes another route: preserve a local graph connecting the hand and object. In its overview, bone directions first provide an initial robot hand configuration. Human hand keypoints and sampled object points become vertices in an interaction mesh. The robot uses corresponding vertices with the same graph connections for comparison. For our cup, a finger is now constrained by nearby object points as well as hand structure. The objective follows the relationship, rather than copying every global point position exactly.

title.zh: 拉普拉斯坐标描述局部差异
title.en: A Laplacian is a local difference

text.zh: 图优化中使用了一个量，叫作加权拉普拉斯坐标。对一个顶点，计算它相对各个邻居的位移，再对这些位移加权平均。TopoRetarget 根据人类参考中的距离，让更近的邻居获得更大权重。机器人在自身关节约束下，尽量复现这些局部差异。如果手和杯子一起移动，相对关系可以保持不变。如果只把手指移开，它与杯子的关系就会立刻变化。这是保持几何关系的目标，不是摩擦或力的估计器。
text.en: The graph objective uses a quantity called a weighted Laplacian coordinate. For one vertex, take its displacement from each neighbor, then average those displacements. TopoRetarget gives nearby neighbors more weight using distances measured in the human reference. The robot tries to reproduce these local differences under its own joint constraints. Move the whole cup and hand together: relative relationships can remain unchanged. Move only the finger away: its relationship with the cup changes immediately. This is a geometric preservation objective, not an estimator of friction or force.

text.zh: 几何优化器可能通过把手指压进物体，来降低接触误差。所以 TopoRetarget 把交互保持、方向、正则项和有符号距离约束结合起来。它的穿透处理同时使用软容差和硬边界。几何模型允许的小幅穿透，不能被当作实测的物理形变。合理的接触分布，仍然只是下游控制器的参考。当杯子离开桌面时，机器人必须真正支撑住它的重量。在这里，仅靠几何已经无法回答完整的操作问题。
text.en: A geometric optimizer can reduce contact error by driving a finger into the object. TopoRetarget combines interaction, direction, regularization, and signed-distance constraints. Its penetration formulation uses a soft tolerance together with a hard bound. A geometric penetration allowance is not a measurement of physical deformation. A plausible contact pattern is still only a reference for the downstream controller. When the cup leaves the table, the robot must actually support its weight. That is where geometry alone stops answering the full manipulation question.

text.zh: DexFlow 补充了一个实际问题：检测到的接触在相邻帧反复跳变，怎么办？这张原始流程图从重建的人手与物体序列，以及初始机器人映射开始。双阈值接触检测与时间处理，用于稳定这些接触信息。随后逐根优化手指，结合接触距离、方向对齐与穿透项。当一次稳定抓握被噪声几何交替判成接触和分离时，这个思路很有用。但它的仿真抓取生成评测，与连续真机遥操作的协议并不相同。
text.en: DexFlow adds a practical question: what happens when detected contact flickers between frames? Its pipeline starts with reconstructed hand-object sequences and an initial robot mapping. A dual-threshold contact detector and temporal processing stabilize the contact information. It refines fingers sequentially using contact distance, alignment, and penetration terms. This helps when noisy geometry reports flickering contact during an otherwise steady grasp. Its simulated grasp-generation protocol differs from continuous real-world teleoperation.

text.zh: Morphometric Imitation 处理另一种误差来源：手的比例本身。其中的形态优化，首先把人手模型适配到机器人手型。原图展示了手型匹配、接触匹配和机器人姿态恢复三个阶段。改变手掌宽度或手指长度，可能破坏缩放之前正确的接触。所以第二阶段要重新调整适配后的手姿，恢复示范中的接触位置。最后，通过骨架迁移和逆运动学恢复机器人关节构型。这就把手型适配，与修复适配造成的接触变化，明确分开了。
text.en: Morphometric Imitation addresses a different source of error: hand proportions themselves. Its morphometric optimization first adapts a human hand model to the robot morphology. The figure separates morphology matching, contact matching, and robot pose recovery. Changing palm width or finger length can destroy contacts that were correct before scaling. The second stage therefore reposes the adapted hand to recover the demonstrated contact locations. Finally, skeletal transfer and inverse kinematics recover robot joint configurations. This separates morphology adjustment from solving the contact damage it creates.

text.zh: C2Dex 也说明了为什么整条系统和重定向模块的结果必须分开标注。它的独立重定向比较，向各方法提供参考真值手物轨迹。端到端比较则从视频开始，包含重建误差与残差学习。真机展示采用受控条件下的开环轨迹回放，并非通用扰动恢复策略。这张图展示了更合理的接触，但单张图片不能证明完整任务成功率。物体位姿漂移，以及频繁的接触切换，仍是这套流程的重要局限。

text.zh: 回到这个杯子，按固定顺序检查动作迁移。先核对物体位姿和尺度，再检查接触标签与表面对应。接着检查机器人能否在不违反关节和碰撞约束的前提下到达这些接触。最后测试真实的力，能否在提起和搬运过程中持续支撑物体。像 ReForce 这样的力感知方法，会加入实测接触反馈来修正动作参考。这需要额外传感器，不能默认为纯相机系统已经具备的能力。下一章沿着这条边界，从几何参考走向物理上可执行的行为。
text.en: Return to the cup and inspect the transfer in a fixed order. First verify object pose and scale, then inspect the contact labels and surface correspondence. Next check whether the robot reaches those contacts within joint and collision constraints. Finally test whether real forces keep the object supported during lift and transport. Force-aware methods such as ReForce add measured contact feedback to correct a motion reference. That requires additional sensing; it cannot silently be assumed in a camera-only system. The next chapter crosses from geometric references into physically executable behavior.

title.en: The pose is right. Why does it drop?

text.zh: 手指准确到达杯子，手腕一动，杯子却掉了。这种失败，并不一定说明几何映射本身错了。实际抓握还要承受重力、加速度，以及不断变化的接触条件。参考轨迹告诉我们机器人应到哪里，却没解决力如何让它到达。这一章，我们来看如何把物理执行加入人体动作迁移。我们会区分仿真可行、学习到的反馈，以及已展示的真机成功。
text.en: The fingers reach the cup correctly, yet the cup falls as soon as the wrist moves. That failure does not necessarily mean the geometric mapping was wrong. The required grip must also withstand gravity, acceleration, and changing contact conditions. A reference trajectory tells us where the robot should go, not how forces will get it there. This chapter follows methods that add physical execution to human motion transfer. We will separate simulated feasibility, learned feedback, and demonstrated real robot success.

title.en: A target is not a force

text.zh: 假设重定向器输出一个期望关节角，我们把它称为参考。低层控制器比较参考与测量角度，再产生电机驱动力。最终运动取决于惯量、摩擦、接触几何，以及控制器本身。直接把仿真手摆进参考姿态，会跳过其中大量过程。所以，一段干净的动画，并不自动等于动力学可行的执行。这里的示意图会分开显示目标、施加的动作，以及实际产生的运动。
text.en: Suppose a retargeter outputs a desired joint angle, which we call the reference. A low-level controller compares that reference with the measured angle and generates motor effort. The resulting motion depends on inertia, friction, contact geometry, and the controller itself. Directly placing a simulated hand into the reference pose skips much of this process. So a clean animation is not automatically a dynamically feasible rollout. Our diagrams distinguish the target, the applied action, and the motion actually achieved.

title.zh: QuasiSim：改变优化所处的物理环境

text.zh: QuasiSim 从一个困难出发：经过接触过程的优化常常不稳定。一个微小变化，就可能让手指接触、错过，或撞上物体。原论文图中，手暂时被放松为一个参数化点集模型。可调节的弹簧与阻尼行为，让初期接触优化更容易。残差物理模块用来补偿解析模拟器难以准确描述的效应。这些变化针对的是优化所用的物理模型，而不只是一个指尖距离损失。
text.en: QuasiSim starts from a difficult problem: optimizing through contact is often unstable. A tiny change can make a finger touch, miss, or collide with an object. In the original figure, the hand is temporarily relaxed into a parameterized point-set model. Adjustable spring and damping behavior makes early contact optimization easier. A residual physics component models effects that the analytical simulator does not capture well. These changes concern the physics model used for optimization, not just a fingertip distance loss.

text.zh: SPIDER 的核心重定向求解器，避免为每条轨迹训练一个新策略。原论文管线先提取手部运动、物体几何与物体运动。机器人运动学参考随后引导多个候选动作序列的并行仿真。它给这些执行评分，再逐渐把搜索集中到更有希望的候选附近。它输出的是经过物理仿真的控制轨迹，而不是通用的学习式手部映射器。鲁棒化与后续策略学习属于额外阶段，各有自己的目的和成本。
text.en: SPIDER avoids training a new policy for every trajectory in its core retargeting solver. The original pipeline first extracts hand motion, object geometry, and object motion. A kinematic robot reference then guides parallel simulations of candidate action sequences. It scores those rollouts and gradually focuses its search around promising candidates. Its output is a physically simulated control trajectory, not a universal learned hand mapper. Robustification and later policy learning are additional stages with their own purposes and costs.

text.zh: 两只机器人手模仿同一个捏合动作，却只有一只成功搬走杯子。哪种方法更好，取决于我们事先约定测什么。姿态映射器、接触规划器和控制器，解决的是不同问题。我们需要用评测协议，分清每个组件的贡献。首先固定问题、输入，以及成功的定义。随后在对应层级比较证据，并保留每一次失败。
text.en: Two robot hands imitate the same pinch, but only one carries the cup successfully. Which method is better depends on what we agreed to measure. A pose mapper, a contact planner, and a controller solve different problems. We need a protocol that identifies the contribution of each component. Start by freezing the question, the inputs, and the definition of success. Then compare evidence at the correct layer, while retaining every failed attempt.

Report penetration depth and how often it exceeds the chosen tolerance. A small average can hide a brief, severe collision during a crucial contact transition.

title.en: Smoothness and latency are a pair

text.zh: 用同样的时间戳和滤波设置，估计关节速度、加速度和 jerk。Jerk 衡量加速度变化的快慢；带噪微分可能把它放大。更强平滑可能降低抖动，却推迟操作者要求的动作。延迟应从相机曝光测到机器人响应，而不只测网络推理。应在指定硬件上报告中位延迟、尾部延迟、掉帧和超时。生成吞吐、控制频率和端到端延迟，是不同的量。
text.en: Estimate joint velocity, acceleration, and jerk using the same timestamps and filtering choices. Jerk measures how quickly acceleration changes; noisy differentiation can inflate it. Stronger smoothing may reduce jitter while delaying the motion an operator requested. Measure delay from camera exposure to the robot response, not just neural inference. Report median and tail latency, dropouts, and timeouts on the stated hardware. Generation throughput, control frequency, and end-to-end delay describe different quantities.

text.zh: 搬运杯子时，要分别记录接触、承重提起、运输、放置和释放。测试前定义离地高度、保持时长、目标区域和超时条件。短暂提起，不能代替完成整个动作序列。不同方法之间，应固定物体几何、质量、摩擦、控制增益和仿真设置。评价无辅助物理执行之前，必须移除人为支撑力。仿真和真机实验应分开报告，并包含复位、掉落和恢复尝试。
text.en: For a cup transfer, record contact, load-bearing lift, transport, placement, and release separately. Define the required clearance, hold duration, target region, and timeout before testing. A brief lift cannot stand in for completing the entire sequence. Freeze object geometry, mass, friction, controller gains, and simulation settings across methods. Artificial support forces must be removed before judging unaided physical execution. Separate simulated and real results, including resets, dropped objects, and recovery attempts.

title.en: Keep the failures in the denominator

text.zh: ManipTrans 在成功轨迹上报告跟踪误差，同时另外报告成功率。两种方法成功的样本子集不同时，这个限定尤其重要。如果困难样本全部失败，方法仍可能显示很低的条件误差。要同时展示仅成功样本误差、整体完成率，以及尝试次数。应保留失败视频和终止原因，不能默默丢掉无法使用的执行。如果还比较共同成功子集上的误差，也要明确标注这层筛选。
text.en: ManipTrans reports tracking errors on successful trajectories, alongside its separate success rates. That qualification matters whenever two methods succeed on different subsets. A method can show low conditional error after failing on every difficult example. Keep successful-only error, overall completion rate, and the number of attempts visible together. Preserve failure videos and termination reasons, rather than silently discarding unusable rollouts. If comparing errors on a shared successful subset, label that additional selection explicitly.

title.zh: 人和扰动也会改变结果

text.zh: 遥操作中，人会补偿映射误差，因此操作者经验会影响结果。应报告练习时间、重复次数、任务顺序，以及是否做了顺序平衡。各条件下的相机视角、视觉反馈和延迟，应尽可能一致。测试留出的操作者，以及共同的遮挡、追踪噪声和物体初态偏移。报告不同操作者和随机种子的波动，并在试验层面估计不确定性。数千个相邻视频帧，并不等于数千次独立操作试验。
text.en: In teleoperation, people compensate for mapping errors, so operator experience affects the outcome. Report practice time, repeated trials, task order, and whether order was counterbalanced. Keep camera views, visual feedback, and latency comparable across conditions. Test new people with shared occlusion, tracking noise, and initial object displacement. Report variation across people and seeds, with uncertainty estimated at the trial level. Thousands of neighboring video frames are not thousands of independent manipulation trials.

text.zh: 无穿戴摄像头系统，首先要稳定可见手部追踪和坐标对齐。先建立几何 baseline，再定位主要失败，决定是否增加复杂度。学习映射的响应与准备成本适合部署时，再选择它。交互几何出错时加入物体约束，物理执行出错时加入反馈控制。论文里的最佳结果，是特定协议下的证据，不是普适冠军。真正有用的答案，是哪个组件在可复现测试中改善了你的完整任务。
text.en: For a camera-only system, first stabilize visible hand tracking and coordinate alignment. Establish a geometric baseline, then locate the dominant failure before adding complexity. Use learned mapping when its response and preparation costs fit your deployment. Add object constraints for interaction errors, and feedback control for physical execution errors. Treat published best results as protocol-specific evidence, never a universal winner. The useful answer is which component improves your complete task under a reproducible test.

description.zh: 先给每个人机关节建立对应，统一零位、正负方向与运动范围，再复制角度。它检验的是：只修正表示和标定，是否已经足够。
description.en: Establish joint correspondence, neutral angles, signs and ranges before copying rotations. This tests how far calibration alone can take us.

input.zh: 人手关节旋转、明确的轴与自由度对应、零位和范围标定。
input.en: Human joint rotations, explicit axis/DoF correspondence, calibrated neutral poses and ranges.

output.zh: 机器人独立关节目标；机械联动关系随后展开为完整骨架。
output.en: Independent robot joint targets, expanded into the full skeleton through mechanical coupling.

objective.zh: qⱼ = clip(aⱼ θₘ₍ⱼ₎ + bⱼ)。比例 a、偏移 b 与对应表 m 都是配置的一部分。
objective.en: qⱼ = clip(aⱼ θₘ₍ⱼ₎ + bⱼ). The scale a, offset b and correspondence m are all part of the baseline.

constraints.zh: 关节限位、机械耦合、关节命名及顺序必须一致；腕部运动另行处理。
constraints.en: Respect joint limits, mechanical couplings, joint names and ordering. Handle wrist motion separately.

training.zh: 无需训练映射网络；需要做几何与关节标定。
training.en: No mapper training; joint and geometric calibration are required.

protocol.zh: 这是教学基线，不是独立发表的方法。DexMV 示例中的关节映射用于初始化，不能代表整个 DexMV。
protocol.en: This is a teaching baseline, not a separately published method. Joint mapping initializes an official DexMV example; it is not the whole DexMV method.

limits.zh: 相同角度不能保证相同指尖位置；异构拇指尤其难以一一对应。
limits.en: Equal angles do not imply equal fingertip positions, especially for differently structured thumbs.

description.zh: 把关节角当未知数，用正运动学计算指尖，再把它们拉向目标点。指尖达到同一个点时，中间指节仍可能有不同姿态。
description.en: Treat joint angles as unknowns, compute tips with FK, and pull them toward target positions. Identical tip positions can conceal different intermediate-joint configurations.

input.zh: 统一坐标系中的对应指尖或连杆位置。固定手腕和浮动手腕是不同设定。
input.en: Corresponding tip/link positions in a common frame. Fixed and floating wrists are different problem settings.

output.zh: 机器人关节 q；必须声明是否同时优化手腕或机械臂。
output.en: Robot joints q, with an explicit choice about optimizing the wrist or arm.

objective.zh: 位置误差＋姿态偏好＋可选时间正则。教学式为 L2；库中 PositionOptimizer 对坐标残差用 SmoothL1。
objective.en: Position error plus posture preference and optional temporal regularization. The teaching equation uses L2; PositionOptimizer uses coordinate-wise SmoothL1.

constraints.zh: 关节界限与机械耦合；碰撞、速度、力矩约束需要额外添加。
constraints.en: Joint bounds and couplings. Collision, velocity and torque constraints must be added explicitly.

training.zh: 通常逐帧优化；暖启动只是从上一帧解开始，并不自动构成平滑目标。
training.en: Usually optimized per frame. Warm-starting from the previous solution is not itself a smoothing objective.

protocol.zh: 比较时统一目标点、缩放、手腕自由度、优化预算、初始化与滤波。
protocol.en: Match target points, scale, wrist freedom, optimization budget, initialization and filtering.

limits.zh: 小指尖误差不能证明无穿透或抓取稳定；冗余、奇异和噪声可改变解。
limits.en: Low tip error proves neither collision avoidance nor grasp stability. Redundancy, singularities and noise can change the solution.

description.zh: 保留指定点对之间的长度与方向。腕到指尖保留整体形状，拇指到其他指尖更直接约束捏合。
description.en: Preserve lengths and directions between selected landmark pairs. Wrist-to-tip edges emphasize hand shape; thumb-to-tip edges emphasize opposition.

input.zh: 经过轴向对齐与尺度处理的人手有向边。
input.en: Directed human landmark pairs after axis alignment and scaling.

output.zh: 匹配对应机器人 FK 向量的关节目标。
output.en: Joint targets matching the corresponding robot FK vectors.

objective.zh: Σ w ρ(‖v_robot − s R v_human‖) 加时间正则；边集合、鲁棒损失和权重位置必须明确。
objective.en: Σ w ρ(‖v_robot − s R v_human‖), optionally with temporal regularization. Specify edges, robust loss and where weights enter.

constraints.zh: 限位与耦合；输入向量仍需统一旋转坐标和左右手约定。
constraints.en: Bounds and couplings; vector inputs still require common rotation and handedness conventions.

training.zh: 逐帧求解。AnyTeleop 论文用平方误差，当前库的 VectorOptimizer 对向量残差范数用 SmoothL1。
training.en: Per-frame optimization. AnyTeleop uses squared error; the current library applies SmoothL1 to vector-residual norms.

protocol.zh: 改变边集合就是改变 baseline；不能只写“使用 IK”而省略配置。
protocol.en: Changing the edge set changes the baseline. “Using IK” is not a reproducible specification.

limits.zh: 相减抵消平移但不抵消旋转；不输入物体时，损失不知道接触在哪里。
limits.en: Subtraction cancels translation, not rotation. Without object input, the loss does not know where contact should occur.

description.zh: 把同一个几何关系拆成三个可比较假设：只保长度、只保方向、同时保留两者。
description.en: Separate one geometric relation into three hypotheses: preserve length, preserve direction, or preserve both.

input.zh: 同一组人手关键点对及机器人 FK 点对。
input.en: The same human landmark pairs and robot FK pairs.

output.zh: 三种不同几何目标下的机器人关节。
output.en: Robot joints optimized under three different geometric objectives.

objective.zh: 距离匹配标量长度；方向匹配单位向量；完整向量匹配长度与方向。
objective.en: Distance matches scalar lengths; direction matches unit vectors; full-vector matching preserves both.

constraints.zh: 使用同一模型、关节约束和求解预算；归一化的数值 ε 不是捏合阈值。
constraints.en: Use the same model, bounds and solver budget. Numerical ε for normalization is not a pinch threshold.

training.zh: 这是数学教学消融，不需要配对学习数据。
training.en: This is a mathematical teaching ablation; no paired training data is required.

protocol.zh: 本课不声称原论文都做过这三个对照。互动面板中的数值来自简化模型实时求解。
protocol.en: We do not claim every cited paper tested these three variants. Lab numbers come from the displayed simplified model.

limits.zh: 距离无法决定朝向，方向不保证间距，一条向量也无法决定绕自身轴的旋转。
limits.en: Distance cannot determine orientation; direction cannot determine separation; one vector cannot fix rotation about its own axis.

description.zh: 在指尖之外加入中间指节关系，减少相同指尖位置对应不同弯曲形状的歧义。再把几何轨迹送入独立的动作估计阶段。
description.en: Add intermediate-finger relationships to reduce bending ambiguity, then pass geometric trajectories to a separate action-estimation stage.

input.zh: 估计的 MANO 姿态、形状、根位姿及对应任务空间向量。
input.en: Estimated MANO pose, shape, root pose and corresponding task-space vectors.

output.zh: 机器人关节序列；动作或力矩示范还需后续估计。
output.en: Robot joint sequences; action or torque demonstrations require further estimation.

objective.zh: 人机任务空间向量误差＋相邻帧关节差。论文图 3 画出十个 TSV，报告 α=0.008。
objective.en: Human–robot task-space vector error plus adjacent-frame joint differences. Figure 3 shows ten TSVs; the paper reports α=0.008.

constraints.zh: 实现中的机器人限位；共同坐标系、尺度与中间指节对应需固定。
constraints.en: Robot limits in the implementation; freeze frames, scale and intermediate-link correspondence.

training.zh: SLSQP 逐帧暖启动，之后还有轨迹拟合及动作估计。
training.en: SLSQP with sequential warm starts, followed by trajectory fitting and action estimation.

protocol.zh: 按 2108.05877v5 核验。当前作者示例的 link 截取及位置优化包装并非论文十向量原式的逐字复现。
protocol.en: Checked against 2108.05877v5. Current example link selection and its positional wrapper are not a literal reproduction of the paper’s ten-vector formulation.

limits.zh: 几何轨迹不保证动力学可行；最终 RL 成功率无法单独归因于重定向目标。
limits.en: Geometric trajectories do not ensure dynamic feasibility. Final RL success cannot be attributed solely to the retargeting objective.

description.zh: 人手进入捏合区域时，不再机械复制测得距离，而是投影到更小的机器人目标长度，并提高相应权重。
description.en: When human fingers enter a pinch region, project their measured separation to a smaller robot target and increase the relevant weights.

input.zh: 跟踪得到的人手模型构型；向量在各自起点局部坐标系表达。
input.en: Tracked human model configurations, with vectors expressed in their respective origin frames.

output.zh: Allegro 手关节构型；机械臂运动单独处理。
output.en: Allegro joint configurations; arm motion is handled separately.

objective.zh: ½Σ s(d)‖r_robot − f(d) r̂_human‖² + γ‖q‖²。开手与两类投影使用不同目标长度和权重。
objective.en: ½Σ s(d)‖r_robot − f(d) r̂_human‖² + γ‖q‖². Open and two projected branches use different target lengths and weights.

constraints.zh: 三根主指远端与中间关节耦合；零位姿态正则、SLSQP 和输出低通。
constraints.en: Distal/medial coupling on three fingers, zero-pose regularization, SLSQP and output low-pass filtering.

training.zh: 在线运动学求解。原文没有报告数值 ε，也没有明确 3/5 cm 双阈值滞回。
training.en: Online kinematic optimization. The original paper does not give a numerical ε or specify 3/5 cm hysteresis.

protocol.zh: 核验 1910.03135v2。0.0001 m 是投影目标向量长度，不是传感精度或实际指腹间隙。
protocol.en: Verified against 1910.03135v2. The 0.0001 m value is a projected target-vector length, not sensor accuracy or a physical fingertip gap.

limits.zh: 高权重仍是软目标；不含物体或接触力，投影也可能影响及时释放。
limits.en: Large weights remain soft objectives. No object or contact forces are modeled; projection can also affect timely release.

title.zh: 上篇 · 如何恢复人手状态
中篇 · 从指尖几何到机器人动作
title.en: Part 2 · From Fingertip Geometry to Robot Motion

title.zh: 下篇 · 实验、证据与局限

description.zh: 保留捏合投影思路，加入有状态的进入/退出阈值、鲁棒损失和上一帧偏好。应与 2019 论文分开命名。
description.en: Retains pinch projection while adding stateful entry/exit thresholds, robust loss and previous-frame preference. Name it separately from the 2019 paper.

input.zh: 配置指定的 2–5 指与手腕向量，坐标已对齐。
input.en: Configured wrist/fingertip vectors for two to five fingers, already frame-aligned.

output.zh: target_joint_names 指定的机器人关节。
output.en: Robot joints specified by target_joint_names.

objective.zh: 向量残差范数的加权 SmoothL1、投影状态及上一帧正则梯度。
objective.en: Weighted SmoothL1 on vector-residual norms, projection state and a previous-frame regularization gradient.

constraints.zh: 模型限位、启用时的 mimic adaptor；默认参数及配置构造路径都需核查。
constraints.en: Model limits, mimic adaptor when enabled, and verification of both defaults and configuration construction.

training.zh: 默认 3 cm 进入、5 cm 退出形成滞回；逐帧求解，非学习网络。
training.en: Default 3 cm entry and 5 cm exit form hysteresis; per-frame optimization, not a learned network.

protocol.zh: 固定 commit 3f56141。该版本标量 cost 与含正则梯度并不完全一致；复现需保存原版或修正版。
protocol.en: Pinned to commit 3f56141. Its scalar cost and regularized gradient are not fully consistent; record whether reproductions use original or repaired code.

limits.zh: 滞回会改变释放响应；默认参数不一定等于具体配置最终生效参数。
limits.en: Hysteresis changes release response. Defaults do not always equal the parameters actually used by a configuration.

description.zh: 把视觉感知、手部向量重定向和机械臂运动生成连接起来。系统的通用性与单个 loss 的贡献要分别评价。
description.en: Connects perception, vector-based hand mapping and arm motion generation. Evaluate system versatility separately from an individual loss.

input.zh: 一台或多台 RGB/RGB-D 相机；局部关键点和全局腕位姿。
input.en: One or more RGB/RGB-D cameras producing local landmarks and global wrist pose.

output.zh: 手部关节目标与独立机械臂运动生成指令。
output.en: Hand joint targets and separate arm motion-generation commands.

objective.zh: 缩放的人手向量与 FK 向量平方误差，加相邻帧关节差；手部限位。
objective.en: Squared errors between scaled human and FK vectors, plus adjacent-frame joint differences under hand bounds.

constraints.zh: 手部与机械臂分别处理约束；跨形态仍需定义对应。
constraints.en: Hand and arm constraints are handled separately; cross-morphology correspondence still needs definition.

training.zh: 在线优化手部映射；dex-retargeting 库源于该项目并持续演化。
training.en: Online hand optimization; dex-retargeting originated from the project and continues to evolve.

protocol.zh: 2307.04577 式 1。换整套系统会同时改变相机、感知、规划和反馈，无法只归因于重定向。
protocol.en: Equation 1 of 2307.04577. Replacing the entire system changes cameras, perception, planning and feedback, so gains cannot be assigned only to retargeting.

limits.zh: 库名不是唯一算法，Position、Vector 和 DexPilot 配置需要另行指定。
limits.en: The library name does not identify one algorithm: specify Position, Vector or DexPilot and its configuration.

description.zh: 把全局拇指位置、弱腕姿态、整体手形、捏合和指尖末段方向组合起来，让手腕适当让位以保留操作意图。
description.en: Combines global thumb position, weak wrist orientation, hand shape, pinch and distal-tip direction, allowing the wrist to yield to manipulation intent.

input.zh: 腕部局部关键点、世界系腕位姿、机器人模型与对应标定。
input.en: Wrist-local landmarks, world-frame wrist pose, robot model and correspondence calibration.

output.zh: 联合优化的机械臂—手关节构型。
output.en: A jointly optimized arm–hand configuration.

objective.zh: L_thumb + L_wrist + L_shape + L_direction + L_pinch + L_joint + L_temporal；各项有独立权重。
objective.en: L_thumb + L_wrist + L_shape + L_direction + L_pinch + L_joint + L_temporal, with explicit weights.

constraints.zh: 关节界限、姿态偏好、机械联动与具体 profile；DIP→tip 仅约束末段轴向。
constraints.en: Joint bounds, posture preferences, couplings and the chosen profile. DIP→tip constrains a distal axis, not full orientation.

training.zh: 逐帧优化；论文显示式与当前代码的 SmoothL1、角误差平方存在差别。
training.en: Per-frame optimization. The paper’s displayed equations differ from current code using SmoothL1 and squared angular error.

protocol.zh: 2506.09384v2；A1–A8 是目标消融，A2/A4 不等于完整 DexPilot/DexMV。AKO 是本课简称。
protocol.en: 2506.09384v2; A1–A8 are objective ablations, and A2/A4 are not full DexPilot/DexMV baselines. AKO is our teaching shorthand.

limits.zh: 多项损失可能冲突；低几何误差没有自动保证接触力或所有任务最优。
limits.en: Objectives can conflict. Low geometric error does not guarantee contact forces or optimality across all tasks.

methods.version: arXiv:2506.09384v2, 24 Dec 2025; author website lists RAP 2026 / 3846d3fa207165bb0d498145aac8b885a28ea923

sources.title: Analyzing Key Objectives in Human-to-Robot Retargeting for Dexterous Manipulation
sources.version: arXiv:2506.09384v2, 24 Dec 2025; author website lists RAP 2026

description.zh: 把在线搜索摊销到训练阶段：网络先预测关节，再通过可微 FK 计算几何能量，把梯度传回网络。
description.en: Amortizes online search into training: predict joints, evaluate geometric energy through differentiable FK, and propagate gradients back to the mapper.

input.zh: 在线单目 RGB 经人体/手姿态估计得到 MANO；手臂使用腕部相对躯干运动。
input.en: Monocular RGB is converted to MANO estimates; a separate arm route uses wrist motion relative to the torso.

output.zh: Allegro 16 关节目标和独立机械臂末端目标。
output.en: Allegro 16-joint targets and a separate arm end-effector target.

objective.zh: 相对 keyvector 几何能量、姿态相似性和学习到的自碰撞惩罚。
objective.en: Relative keyvector energy, pose similarity and a learned self-collision penalty.

constraints.zh: 碰撞分类器提供软训练惩罚；实际执行仍依赖安全裁剪和控制。
constraints.en: A collision classifier supplies a soft training penalty; execution still depends on clipping and control.

training.zh: 人体图像/视频姿态提供输入，不需要密集人机配对角度；碰撞标签来自仿真检测器。
training.en: Human image/video poses provide inputs without dense paired robot angles; collision labels come from a simulator checker.

protocol.zh: DexPilot-Monocular* 是作者单目版本；500 条 DexYCB 序列、相同能量、40 ms 在线求解预算。
protocol.en: DexPilot-Monocular* is the authors’ monocular variant: 500 DexYCB sequences, matched energy and a 40 ms online solve budget.

limits.zh: 附录整套系统约 25 Hz，不能用网络推理速度代替端到端速度；人仍通过观察闭合任务回路。
limits.en: The appendix reports about 25 Hz for the system. Network inference speed is not end-to-end speed; the operator still closes the task loop.

description.zh: 学习整个可控空间的映射，而不只拟合一张姿态：移动方向应一致、空间利用要充分、不同区域的响应不应忽快忽慢。
description.en: Learns a controllable mapping across the workspace, preserving motion direction, coverage and reasonably uniform local response rather than one isolated pose.

input.zh: 腕坐标系中的人手指尖位置及手指对应。
input.en: Human fingertip positions in the wrist frame, with finger correspondence.

output.zh: 目标机器人关节角。
output.en: Target robot joint angles.

objective.zh: 方向、覆盖、响应均匀性、捏合对应与自碰撞五类几何目标。
objective.en: Geometric objectives for direction, coverage, response uniformity, pinch correspondence and self-collision.

constraints.zh: 运动范围与碰撞主要通过训练目标处理；软约束不是逐帧硬保证。
constraints.en: Workspace and collision properties are encouraged through training; soft objectives are not per-frame hard guarantees.

training.zh: 人体自由活动/捏合样本、机器人 FK 采样及碰撞标签；不需要密集配对机器人姿态。
training.en: Human free-motion/pinch samples, robot FK samples and collision labels, without dense paired robot poses.

protocol.zh: 原论文真机是 Manus+Vive、Allegro+Franka；87.5% 是该抓取协议，1 kHz 是重定向环节。
protocol.en: Real experiments use Manus+Vive and Allegro+Franka. The 87.5% figure belongs to that grasping protocol; 1 kHz describes retargeting.

limits.zh: 不输入物体或接触力；flatness 指空间响应均匀，不等于时间低通滤波。
limits.en: No object or force input. Flatness means uniform spatial response, not temporal low-pass filtering.

description.zh: 先学人机指尖空间对应，再修正捏合状态，最后由逆映射得到关节。少量示例锚点帮助消除仅靠空间分布的歧义。
description.en: Learns fingertip-space correspondence, refines pinch state, then maps back to joints. A few gesture anchors resolve ambiguity left by distributions alone.

input.zh: 人手指尖位置；训练时另有人机空间与稀疏 gesture anchors。
input.en: Human fingertip positions; training also uses workspace samples and sparse gesture anchors.

output.zh: 修正的机器人指尖目标，再经 f_s 输出关节；f_s 可用 IK、近邻或网络。
output.en: Refined robot fingertip targets followed by f_s for joints; f_s may use IK, nearest neighbors or a network.

objective.zh: Partial Chamfer、点对距离、局部运动方向与 anchor 对齐。
objective.en: Partial Chamfer, pairwise distances, local motion direction and anchor alignment.

constraints.zh: 捏合分类及逆映射带来额外假设；并非直接复制人手角度。
constraints.en: Pinch classification and inverse mapping add assumptions; this is not direct copying of human angles.

training.zh: 自监督空间数据＋少量配对示例；calibration-free 不等于无人指导或无需跟踪。
training.en: Self-supervised workspace data plus sparse paired examples; calibration-free does not mean no guidance or tracking.

protocol.zh: 7 种手、5 seeds；速度表中 GeoRT 281.7 Hz、AnyDexRT 293.0 Hz 属同一协议。真机使用 Manus+Vive。
protocol.en: Seven hands and five seeds; GeoRT 281.7 Hz and AnyDexRT 293.0 Hz share this paper’s speed protocol. Real experiments use Manus+Vive.

limits.zh: 不能跨论文与 GeoRT 的 1 kHz 直接计算倍率；核验时作者代码仍 Coming Soon。
limits.en: Do not divide these values by GeoRT’s separate 1 kHz report. Official code was marked Coming Soon when checked.

description.zh: 把“哪一块手表面应接触物体”从源手迁移到目标手，不把整个操作压缩成五个指尖点。
description.en: Transfers which surface regions should contact the object instead of compressing manipulation into five fingertip points.

input.zh: 完整手物序列、准确 mesh、稠密接触、人工虚拟标记和轴向曲线。
input.en: Full hand–object sequences, accurate meshes, dense contacts, artist markers and axial curves.

output.zh: 平滑的目标手运动学轨迹。
output.en: Smooth target-hand kinematic trajectories.

objective.zh: 非等距表面对应迁移 contact patch，再以接触和标记细化轨迹并做 IK。
objective.en: Non-isometric surface correspondence transfers contact patches, followed by contact/marker refinement and IK.

constraints.zh: 作者实现需要连续 manifold wrapper；普通非连通 URDF link 不是直接等价输入。
constraints.en: The author implementation requires a connected manifold wrapper; disconnected URDF links are not equivalent inputs.

training.zh: 离线整段处理；不属于密集配对网络训练路线。
training.en: Offline whole-sequence processing, not a dense paired neural-training route.

protocol.zh: 30 个组合＝5 目标手×6 动作；基线额外得到完整轨迹、真实 root 估计及平滑，以隔离目标影响。
protocol.en: Thirty combinations: five target hands × six motions. Baselines receive whole trajectories, root estimates and smoothing to isolate objective differences.

limits.zh: 主要是运动学证据；接触区域正确不等于摩擦或力足够。大形态差异可能使原接触不可保持。
limits.en: Primarily kinematic evidence. Correct patches do not prove sufficient forces or friction; large morphology changes can make source contacts infeasible.

methods.version: 2402.04820v1; journal DOI 10.1145/3723872 exists, final version not separately audited

description.zh: 用手和物体共同构成邻接图，保留每个点相对邻居加权中心的位置，再用独立控制策略跟踪生成的参考。
description.en: Builds a hand–object neighborhood graph and preserves each point relative to a weighted neighbor center, then separately trains tracking policies.

input.zh: 人手—物体轨迹、物体 mesh、目标手模型。
input.en: Human hand–object trajectories, object mesh and target-hand model.

output.zh: 机器人运动参考；下游 RL 跟踪策略另行训练。
output.en: Robot motion references; downstream RL trackers are trained separately.

objective.zh: 骨方向初始化＋距离加权交互 Laplacian＋平滑与穿透处理。
objective.en: Bone-direction initialization, distance-weighted interaction Laplacians, smoothing and penetration handling.

constraints.zh: 关节约束及物体几何；原始虚假接触和缺失接触仍会影响结果。
constraints.en: Joint constraints and object geometry; false or missing source contacts remain problematic.

training.zh: 重定向为优化；每套参考再训练匹配的下游 RL。
training.en: Retargeting is optimization; downstream RL is trained for the resulting references.

protocol.zh: ContactPose 25/28 抓握，排除三个深凹物体；Ho-cap 与转笔另作轨迹跟踪评测。
protocol.en: Reference geometry uses 25/28 ContactPose grasps, excluding three deeply concave objects. Ho-cap and pen spinning use separate tracking protocols.

limits.zh: 87.5% 转笔结果属于下游策略，不能说成实时几何映射成功率；核验时官方 Code 按钮禁用。
limits.en: The 87.5% pen-spinning result belongs to downstream tracking, not real-time geometric mapping. The official Code button was disabled when checked.

description.zh: 先学通用手部模仿器，再为手物交互学习残差。基础运动能力可复用，物体相关反馈负责纠正实际操作。
description.en: Learns a reusable hand imitator, then an interaction residual. General motion skills transfer while object-related feedback corrects manipulation.

input.zh: 参考手物轨迹、本体状态、物体形状与状态、仿真接触力。
input.en: Reference hand/object trajectories, proprioception, object state/shape and simulated contact forces.

output.zh: 关节 PD 目标，以及仿真中浮动腕部 6D 力。
output.en: Joint PD targets and a simulated six-dimensional floating-wrist force.

objective.zh: 第一阶段 PPO 手部模仿；第二阶段 a=a_imitator+Δa 的交互残差。
objective.en: Stage-one PPO hand imitation, followed by interaction residuals a=a_imitator+Δa.

constraints.zh: 仿真控制与真实硬件自由度不同，需要适配；成功判据包括手与物体误差。
constraints.en: Simulation and hardware DoFs differ and require adaptation; success thresholds include hand and object errors.

training.zh: 基础预训练约 1.5 天；15 分钟指复用预训练器后的 60 帧 mouse 残差示例。
training.en: Base pretraining takes about 1.5 days. The 15-minute report concerns a 60-frame mouse residual example after reusing pretraining.

protocol.zh: 筛选约 80 条 OakInk-V2、4–20 秒；Retarget-only、RL-only、Retarget+Residual 都是必要对照。
protocol.en: Roughly 80 selected OakInk-V2 clips of 4–20 s, compared with Retarget-only, RL-only and Retarget+Residual.

limits.zh: 误差只统计成功 rollout，必须同时看失败率；不能用单例训练时间做普遍提速宣称。
limits.en: Errors are measured only on successful rollouts, so failure rates must accompany them. One training-time example is not a universal speedup.

description.zh: 先把物理系统变得更容易优化，再逐渐恢复刚性和接触约束。最终必须在撤掉早期辅助后仍能执行。
description.en: Makes the physics easier to optimize, then progressively restores rigidity and contact constraints. The final motion must work without the early assistance.

input.zh: 人体手物参考轨迹、几何与仿真状态。
input.en: Human hand–object reference trajectories, geometry and simulation states.

output.zh: 优化后的机器人控制轨迹。
output.en: Optimized robot control trajectories.

objective.zh: 放松为点集与弹簧阻尼接触，学习残差物理，再通过 curriculum 收紧。
objective.en: Relax to point sets and spring–damper contacts, learn residual physics, then tighten constraints through a curriculum.

constraints.zh: 最终高保真执行条件要恢复；虚拟辅助不能被当成真实完成任务。
constraints.en: Final high-fidelity execution conditions must be restored; virtual assistance is not task completion.

training.zh: 离线逐序列优化；v2 附录默认阶段 2 约 22 小时、阶段 3 约 20 小时，随序列变化。
training.en: Offline per-sequence optimization; the v2 appendix gives roughly 22 h for stage 2 and 20 h for stage 3 under default settings, varying by sequence.

protocol.zh: 比较含改造的 DGrasp-Tracking，不能当成原始 DGrasp 原生 tracking 能力。
protocol.en: Comparisons include modified DGrasp-Tracking; do not attribute this tracking setup to original DGrasp.

limits.zh: 不是即时相机到手控制；时间成本、序列筛选、模拟条件必须一起报告。
limits.en: Not instantaneous camera-to-hand control. Report compute cost, sequence selection and simulation conditions together.

description.zh: 在并行物理模拟中采样候选动作序列、评分、退火细化。生成一段轨迹，不等于学到了对任意新画面泛化的即时策略。
description.en: Samples candidate action sequences in parallel physics, scores them and refines by annealing. Producing a trajectory is not the same as learning an instant policy for arbitrary images.

input.zh: 物体 mesh、初始机器人参考、物体运动与可选接触意图。
input.en: Object mesh, initial robot reference, object motion and optional intended contacts.

output.zh: 动态模拟状态与控制序列。
output.en: Dynamically simulated state and control sequences.

objective.zh: 物理 rollout 下的轨迹评分与采样搜索；+C 加入逐步撤掉的虚拟接触引导。
objective.en: Trajectory scoring and sampling search through physical rollouts; +C adds progressively removed virtual contact guidance.

constraints.zh: 真实动力学与初态；最终虚拟力不能继续扶住物体充当成功。
constraints.en: Physical dynamics and initial-state conditions; virtual forces must not keep supporting the object during final evaluation.

training.zh: 核心 solver 不需要策略优化；下游策略学习另计，接触引导也有额外成本。
training.en: Core solving does not require policy optimization; downstream policy learning and contact guidance have separate costs.

protocol.zh: 按 2511.09484v3：分别对齐 IsaacGym/OakInk 与 Genesis/ARCTIC 协议；ADD-AUC 不是成功率。
protocol.en: For 2511.09484v3, comparisons separately align IsaacGym/OakInk and Genesis/ARCTIC protocols. ADD-AUC is not success rate.

limits.zh: 生成 FPS 是总生成吞吐；6520 条保留数据为仿真轨迹。开环初态敏感和语义错误仍存在。
limits.en: Generation FPS measures total throughput; 6,520 retained trajectories are simulated. Initial-state sensitivity and semantic errors remain.

description.zh: 先将人手演示变为运动学 primitive，再让策略根据任务和物体状态修正动作。
description.en: Converts demonstrations into kinematic primitives, then corrects actions using task and object state.

input.zh: 机器人/物体状态、二值接触、未来参考手物目标。
input.en: Robot/object states, binary contact and future hand/object reference goals.

output.zh: primitive 关节增量叠加残差动作。
output.en: Primitive joint increments plus residual actions.

objective.zh: primitive 为 qₜ−qₜ₋₁；靠近物体前后，奖励的手跟踪与物体跟踪重点变化。
objective.en: The primitive is qₜ−qₜ₋₁; rewards shift emphasis between hand and object tracking around object interaction.

constraints.zh: 动作与奖励由任务控制协议规定；接触切换与长序列漂移仍需检查。
constraints.en: Actions and rewards follow a task-control protocol; contact transitions and long-horizon drift still need evaluation.

training.zh: 增强的人手物体演示和目标条件 RL 残差。
training.en: Augmented hand–object demonstrations and goal-conditioned RL residual learning.

protocol.zh: 2411.04428v2；不是同名 ICCV 2025 handover 数据集。抓取成功与全过程 following 成功分开。
protocol.en: 2411.04428v2, not the same-acronym ICCV 2025 handover dataset. Grasp success and complete following success are distinct.

limits.zh: 误差仅在成功轨迹计算；不同手型不能合成无条件 SOTA 排名。
limits.en: Errors are computed on successful trajectories. Results across hand embodiments do not establish an unconditional ranking.

description.zh: 离线准备几何合理的手指和物体共同子目标，在线由 co-tracking 策略实现接触切换。
description.en: Prepares geometrically meaningful finger–object subgoals offline, then uses an online co-tracking policy to execute contact transitions.

input.zh: 操作者指尖、物体位姿目标与机器人状态。
input.en: Operator fingertip and object-pose goals plus robot state.

output.zh: 学习得到的低层接触执行动作。
output.en: Learned low-level contact-execution actions.

objective.zh: 两阶段几何重定向、连续手物子目标、稀疏子目标与稠密跟踪奖励。
objective.en: Two-stage geometry-aware retargeting, consecutive hand–object subgoals, sparse subgoal and dense tracking rewards.

constraints.zh: 前抓取阶段与 in-hand policy 分开；人需要切换阶段。
constraints.en: Pregrasp and in-hand policies are separate, with human phase switching.

training.zh: 在线控制前训练 RL，并加入域随机化与随机动作掩码。
training.en: RL is trained before deployment, with domain randomization and random action masking.

protocol.zh: 原文 NOKOV 标记手套/物体 30 Hz；七任务 75% 是作者遥操作系统结果。
protocol.en: The paper uses a 30 Hz NOKOV marker-glove/object stream; 75% across seven tasks is a system-level teleoperation result.

limits.zh: 不能宣称普通无穿戴摄像头已复制该成绩；与 GeoRT 单次抓取成功率没有共同分母。
limits.en: Do not claim this performance has been reproduced with bare cameras. It has no shared denominator with GeoRT’s single-grasp success rate.

title.en: OAT: Single-RGB hand and wrist tracking

methods.version: ICRA 2026 accepted author manuscript; White Rose deposit includes a cover page

description.en: Separate finger articulation from wrist pose. Relative 3D landmarks drive hand mapping; their 2D projections locate the wrist.
description.zh: 把手指关节运动与腕位姿分开。相对三维关键点用于手型映射，其二维投影帮助确定手腕位置。

input.en: MediaPipe 21 image landmarks and wrist-relative 3D landmarks; camera intrinsics; robot FK, joint correspondence and bounds.
input.zh: MediaPipe的21个图像关键点、腕部相对三维关键点、相机内参，以及机器人正运动学、关节对应和限位。

output.en: Bounded robot-hand joint targets and separate wrist translation/orientation targets.
output.zh: 受关节限位约束的机器人手目标角度，以及独立的腕平移与旋转目标。

objective.en: Scaled landmark-position error plus temporal regularization; wrist reprojection plus velocity penalty. Palm landmarks define rotation. Grasp stabilization compensates unintended wrist drift.
objective.zh: 缩放关键点的位置误差加时间正则；腕位置用重投影误差和速度惩罚求解。掌部关键点确定旋转，抓握稳定模块补偿不希望的腕漂移。

constraints.en: Hard robot joint bounds; scale/correspondence are configured per hand. Wrist projection depends on the estimated landmarks and camera intrinsics.
constraints.zh: 机器人关节硬限位；每种手配置尺度和对应关系。腕部投影依赖估计的关键点与相机内参。

training.en: No extra retargeting network training; pretrained MediaPipe supplies the landmarks. Calibration and temporal initialization still matter.
training.zh: 不额外训练重定向网络；预训练MediaPipe输出关键点。标定与时间初始化仍然重要。

protocol.zh: FreiHAND用于腕位置估计和标定评测；渲染手图像测试视角；真机试验评估遥操作。 被测试的笔记本约30 Hz，台式机约50 Hz；仅对应本文硬件。其他系统耗时来自各自论文，并非统一硬件重跑。 任务交互比较包含键盘和SpaceMouse；视觉系统运行时间比较使用分别报告的结果。
protocol.en: FreiHAND evaluates wrist estimation and calibration. Rendered hand views test camera viewpoint. Robot trials evaluate teleoperation. About 30 Hz on the tested laptops and 50 Hz on tested desktops. These are system-specific measurements. Other-system timings in its comparison are taken from their papers. Keyboard and SpaceMouse in task interfaces; vision systems in separately sourced runtime comparison.

limits.zh: 无需额外网络训练不等于不依赖学习感知。遮挡和错误三维关键点会传到腕位姿；快速基于手的标定不等于精密计量。 是，论文提出的人体输入路线使用单个RGB相机。
limits.en: No extra network training does not mean no learned perception. Occlusion and wrong 3D landmarks propagate into wrist errors; rough hand-based calibration is not precision metrology. Yes, the proposed human-input route uses one RGB camera.

description.en: Stabilize noisy contacts over time, then refine fingers one at a time.
description.zh: 先在时间上稳定噪声接触，再逐根手指细化。

input.en: Reconstructed MANO hand/object sequences, object geometry and target-hand model.
input.zh: 重建的MANO人手与物体序列、物体几何、目标手模型。

output.en: Retargeted and refined robot grasp trajectories for Shadow and Allegro hands.
output.zh: 面向Shadow与Allegro手的重定向、接触细化抓握轨迹。

objective.en: Initial geometric mapping; hysteresis-like dual contact thresholds with temporal processing; sequential distance, normal-alignment, penetration, self-collision and pose-regularization costs.
objective.zh: 初始几何映射；具有滞回性质的双接触阈值与时间处理；逐指优化接触距离、法向对齐、穿透、自碰撞与姿态正则。

constraints.en: Contact, penetration and self-collision are energy terms; a low geometric loss does not guarantee a dynamically stable grasp. Finger ordering and object scaling are part of the method.
constraints.zh: 接触、穿透与自碰撞通过能量项处理；低几何损失不保证动力学稳定。手指优化顺序与物体缩放也是方法的一部分。

training.en: Optimization-based trajectory processing, not a paired-pose neural mapper. Quality depends on reconstructed input metadata and contact extraction.
training.zh: 基于优化的轨迹处理，不是用人机成对姿态训练的神经映射器。质量依赖输入重建数据和接触提取。

protocol.zh: 报告对50个YCB物体生成29.2万帧右手轨迹；这是生成帧数，不是独立成功的真机示范数。 Isaac Gym/PhysX抓握检查：位置目标向接触方向施压，再在六个重力方向下检查100仿真步。接触后任一合格帧即可让整段序列计为成功。 包含DexRetarget及抓握生成器；其他生成器表格指标引用BODex，不能作为同协议连续遥操作榜单。
protocol.en: Reports 292k right-hand trajectory frames for 50 YCB objects. These are generated frames, not independently successful real demonstrations. Isaac Gym/PhysX grasp test: position targets press contacting links, followed by 100 simulation steps under six gravity directions. Any qualifying post-contact frame can make its sequence count as successful. DexRetarget and grasp generators; other generators’ tabulated metrics are sourced from BODex, so this is not a common continuous-teleoperation benchmark.

limits.zh: 输入重建质量限制接触精度；该抓握协议下维持接触，不等于完整轨迹完成或实测接触力。 不是直接在线纯相机系统；输入是已重建序列。
limits.en: Metadata quality limits contact fidelity. Retained contact under this grasp protocol is not full trajectory completion or measured contact force. No direct live camera-only claim; it consumes reconstructed sequences.

description.en: Reshape MANO toward the robot first, recover the contacts damaged by reshaping, then solve robot poses.
description.zh: 先把MANO手型适配到机器人，再修复手型改变破坏的接触，最后恢复机器人姿态。

input.en: Human hand-object meshes and trajectories, robot skeleton/URDF, joint correspondence and table plane.
input.zh: 人手物体网格与轨迹、机器人骨架/URDF、关节对应和桌面。

output.en: MMO produces a kinematic reference; separate residual RL generates dynamic demonstrations, distilled into category-specific policies.
output.zh: MMO输出运动学参考；独立残差RL生成动力学示范，再蒸馏为按物体类别训练的策略。

objective.en: Morphology alignment, contact-vertex recovery, coupled-finger constraints and collision terms; skeletal transfer plus IK. Reference-contact detection uses 4.5 mm, not the main 5 mm evaluation tolerance.
objective.zh: 手型对齐、接触顶点恢复、耦合手指约束和碰撞项，再做骨架迁移与IK。参考接触检测为4.5 mm，不是主评测的5 mm容差。

constraints.en: Morphology and contact stages preserve shared MANO vertex identities; coupled fingers, table/penetration penalties and robot IK constraints must be retained.
constraints.zh: 手型和接触阶段保持共享MANO顶点身份；耦合手指、桌面/穿透惩罚与机器人IK约束都必须保留。

training.en: MMO is optimization. A separate residual policy is trained from its references, then distilled into a depth/point-cloud visuomotor student. These three costs and outputs are distinct.
training.zh: MMO是优化方法。之后独立训练参考跟踪残差策略，再蒸馏成深度/点云视觉运动学生策略；三阶段成本和产物应分开。

protocol.zh: 10条GRAB动作×Dex3/Allegro/Sharpa。硬件为Sharpa、KUKA和L515深度；30个实物各10个位姿，共300次。 依次比较运动学接触F1/接触片距离、同一残差RL下的动力学表现，再单独测真机。真机成功需提起至少5 cm、完成预期动作、稳定持握至少5秒且不发生硬桌面碰撞。 DexPilot、AnyTeleop、Position、Contact PyRoki、OmniRetarget；仅输出手关节的基线在下游动力学评测中额外配上手臂IK。
protocol.en: Ten GRAB motions × Dex3/Allegro/Sharpa. Hardware: Sharpa with KUKA, L515 depth; 30 physical objects × ten poses = 300 trials. Kinematic contact F1/patch distance, matched downstream residual-RL evaluation, then independent real deployment. Real success requires ≥5 cm lift, expected motion, ≥5 s stable hold and no hard table collision. DexPilot, AnyTeleop, Position, Contact PyRoki, OmniRetarget; hand-only baselines receive additional arm IK for downstream dynamic evaluation.

limits.zh: 89.3%真机成功属于整条训练管线，不是MMO单模块；透明酒杯的深度可观测性用乒乓球辅助。 真机相机输入属于深度策略推理；源GRAB采集与离线训练是另一层要求。
limits.en: 89.3% hardware success is the full trained pipeline, not MMO alone. Transparent wineglass observability was aided with ping-pong balls. Camera-based deployment is depth-policy inference; source GRAB capture and offline training are separate requirements.

title.en: C2Dex: Stable contacts from video to robot
title.zh: C2Dex：从视频到机器人的稳定接触

description.en: Aggregate contact observations in object coordinates; use the resulting stable targets for both reconstruction and robot transfer.
description.zh: 在物体坐标系聚合接触观测；稳定目标同时用于重建细化与机器人迁移。

input.en: Monocular manipulation video, reconstructed hand/object geometry and poses, target robot model.
input.zh: 单目操作视频、重建手物几何与位姿，以及目标机器人模型。

output.en: Refined human HOI, robot reference trajectory and residual-RL-refined executable trajectory.
output.zh: 细化的人类手物交互、机器人参考轨迹，以及残差RL细化后的可执行轨迹。

objective.en: Stable object-side contacts plus shared-graph Laplacian geometry; SDF penetration/self-collision, temporal smoothness and joint limits. ManipTrans-style residual PPO separately refines execution.
objective.zh: 稳定物体侧接触、共享图拉普拉斯关系、SDF穿透/自碰撞、时间平滑和关节限位；独立ManipTrans式残差PPO再细化执行。

constraints.en: Joint limits, temporal smoothness and SDF penetration/self-collision penalties. Stable-contact targets assume sufficiently accurate object poses within local temporal segments.
constraints.zh: 包含关节限位、时间平滑与SDF穿透/自碰撞惩罚。稳定接触目标假设局部时间片段中的物体位姿足够准确。

training.en: First optimize reconstructed HOI and robot references; then residual PPO in Isaac Gym produces an executable trajectory. The policy is used offline; deployment replays the resulting trajectory.
training.zh: 先优化重建HOI与机器人参考，再用Isaac Gym中的残差PPO生成可执行轨迹。策略在离线阶段使用；部署回放所得轨迹。

protocol.zh: 端到端使用45条DexYCB与30条TACO视频；独立重定向评测改用GT手物轨迹，统一为Inspire手。 端到端成功要求物体ATE≤0.10 m且旋转≤1.00 rad（宽）或≤0.50 rad（严）；无效轨迹计失败。真机在受控初态下回放8项任务的24条示范。 端到端：Do As I Do、DexImit。GT输入重定向：DexPilot、AnyTeleop、GeoRT。重建：HOLD、DiffHOI、BIGS。
protocol.en: End-to-end: 45 DexYCB and 30 TACO videos. Isolated retargeting instead receives GT hand-object trajectories for the same Inspire hand. End-to-end success uses object ATE ≤0.10 m and rotation ≤1.00 rad (relaxed) or ≤0.50 rad (strict), invalid trajectories fail. Real replay: 24 demonstrations across eight tasks under controlled initial conditions. End-to-end: Do As I Do, DexImit. GT-input retargeting: DexPilot, AnyTeleop, GeoRT. Reconstruction: HOLD, DiffHOI, BIGS.

limits.zh: 真机部署回放生成轨迹，不运行通用视觉恢复策略；物体位姿漂移与频繁接触切换仍是局限。 源视频采集是纯相机，但仍需离线重建、物体几何和仿真。
limits.en: Real deployment replays a generated trajectory; it does not run a general visual recovery policy. Object-pose drift and frequent contact switching remain limitations. Yes for source-video acquisition, but offline reconstruction, object geometry and simulation are required.

description.en: Sample candidate joint configurations, keep low-cost elites and update their distribution. No dynamics rollout is required for these FK costs.
description.zh: 采样候选关节构型，保留低代价精英并更新分布；这些正运动学代价不需要动力学rollout。

input.en: Aligned human keypoints, robot FK and previous/neutral joint configurations.
input.zh: 对齐的人手关键点、机器人正运动学，以及上一帧和中性关节构型。

output.en: Joint-limit-clipped robot joint commands.
output.zh: 裁剪到关节限位内的机器人关节指令。

objective.en: DexPilot-derived keyvector cost plus neutral-pose and previous-frame regularization. MPOPI uses iCEM adaptive sampling, softmax elite weights and JAX/MJX parallel FK.
objective.zh: 基于DexPilot的关键向量代价，加中性姿态与前帧正则。MPOPI结合iCEM自适应采样、精英softmax权重与JAX/MJX并行FK。

constraints.en: Clips final joint commands to configured limits. This kinematic sampling optimizer does not establish force closure or formal collision-free control.
constraints.zh: 将最终关节指令裁剪到配置限位内。该运动学采样优化器不建立力闭合或形式化无碰撞控制保证。

training.en: No learned retargeting map. Candidate sampling/elite selection is performed online; JAX/MJX parallel FK and the selected sampling budget determine latency.
training.zh: 不训练映射网络；在线进行候选采样与精英选择。JAX/MJX并行正运动学和采样预算共同决定延迟。

protocol.zh: MANUS MetaGloves Pro驱动固定的mimic P0.50手，30 Hz。总计18人，各任务人数12/8/6，每算法对应10/10/20次试验。 平衡拉丁方顺序；标定手套，不做操作者专属重定向调参。结果按1/0.5/0评分；54.1%是该部分得分指标的混合效应估计边际均值。 DexPilot、GeoRT、Hybrid；卡片拾取、立方体垂直轴旋转、螺丝刀转向。
protocol.en: MANUS MetaGloves Pro drives a fixed mimic P0.50 hand at 30 Hz. Eighteen participants overall; task samples are 12/8/6, with ten/ten/twenty trials per algorithm. Balanced Latin Square; glove calibration, no operator-specific retargeter tuning. Score is 1/0.5/0; reported 54.1% is a mixed-effects estimated marginal mean of this partial-credit outcome. DexPilot, GeoRT and Hybrid; card pickup, vertical cube rotation and screwdriver pivot.

limits.zh: 54.1%不是严格二值完整任务成功率。3.664 ms是RTX4090上2000次重定向调用均值，不是相机到机器人延迟；采样平滑不等于稳定性证明。 算法可接收关键点；原用户研究用穿戴手套，改成相机并非论文报告协议。
limits.en: 54.1% is not strict binary full-task success. Mean 3.664 ms is a 2,000-call retargeting benchmark on RTX4090, not camera-to-robot latency. Sampling smoothness is not a stability proof. Algorithm can accept keypoints; original user study uses wearable gloves. Camera substitution was not the reported protocol.

title.en: ReForce: Correct motion with tactile feedback
title.zh: ReForce：利用触觉反馈修正运动

description.en: Correct motion commands when measured robot fingertip forces disagree with demonstrated force intent.
description.zh: 当机器人实测指尖力与示范中的力意图不一致时，修正运动指令。

input.en: Robot joint state and five fingertip normal forces; motion/force references and their errors. Human references use Manus, Quest wrist tracking and calibrated fingertip FSRs.
input.zh: 机器人关节状态与五指法向力、运动/力参考及误差。人类参考用Manus、Quest腕跟踪和经标定的指尖FSR。

output.en: Bounded joint updates accumulated into joint-limit-clipped commands.
output.zh: 有界关节增量，累加成经过关节限位裁剪的指令。

objective.en: Behavior cloning of simulated one-step joint updates, conditioned on post-hoc future-window motion/force targets; MSE balanced across fingers.
objective.zh: 用仿真单步关节增量做行为克隆，以事后未来窗口的运动/力目标为条件，并对各手指均衡计算MSE。

constraints.en: Bounded accumulated joint updates are clipped to hardware limits. Human/robot force measurements require a common Newton scale; task-specific force thresholds define evaluation.
constraints.zh: 有界关节增量累加后裁剪到硬件限位。人机测力需统一到牛顿尺度；任务特定力阈值用于评测定义。

training.en: Supervised behavior cloning on randomized simulation joint-force trajectories. An optional ACT reference policy is trained separately; it predicts motion/force intent and does not replace measured tactile feedback.
training.zh: 用随机化仿真关节-力轨迹做有监督行为克隆。可选ACT参考策略另行训练；其预测运动/力意图，不能替代实测触觉反馈。

protocol.zh: 随机化仿真交互训练一个跟踪器；真机xArm加12自由度XHand测试纸杯与夹钳任务。 分别评估回放参考与学习的ACT参考；力安全成功还要求任务特定力阈值内，且无严重接触缺失。 直接回放/参考策略；导纳控制获得同样的力参考与触觉观测。
protocol.en: Randomized simulation interactions train one tracker. Real xArm + 12-DoF XHand tests paper-cup and tongs tasks. Separate replayed-reference and learned-ACT-reference experiments. Force-safe success additionally requires bounded task-specific force and no severe missing-contact failure. Direct replay/reference policy; admittance control receives the same force reference and tactile observations.

limits.zh: 并非所有任务最佳：学习参考的夹钳力安全成功为54.5%，导纳控制为90%。一条缺触觉的纸杯试验不计入力统计。推理无需数字孪生不等于无需力传感器。 否；原人体输入与机器人反馈依赖额外穿戴和触觉传感器。
limits.en: Not uniformly best: learned-reference tongs force-safe success is 54.5%, versus admittance 90%. One paper-cup trial with missing tactile data is excluded from force statistics. No digital twin at inference does not mean no force sensing. No; original human input and robot feedback use additional wearable/tactile sensors.

title.en: SoftAct: Force-guided transfer to soft hands
title.zh: SoftAct：向软手机器人迁移接触力意图

description.en: Assign fingers by demonstrated load, then move their targets toward geodesically nearby contacts.
description.zh: 按示范负载分配手指，再把指尖目标向表面测地距离相近的接触区域调整。

input.en: VR human hand kinematics, virtual object motion, simulated contact patches/forces and soft robot model. Capture uses ten OptiTrack cameras and 24 hand markers.
input.zh: VR人手运动、虚拟物体运动、仿真接触片/力与软手机器人模型。采集使用10台OptiTrack相机和24个人手标记。

output.en: Refined robot trajectories train a diffusion policy; a learned forward model plus optimization converts desired fingertip motion into pneumatic pressures.
output.zh: 细化机器人轨迹用于训练扩散策略；学习的前向模型配合优化，把指尖目标运动转成气压。

objective.en: Offline geodesic force-load allocation; online force-weighted contact refinement; separate low-level pressure tracking.
objective.zh: 离线测地力负载分配、在线力加权接触细化，以及独立的底层气压跟踪。

constraints.en: The offline finger allocation remains fixed during a rollout. Contact-based target adjustments are magnitude-bounded; hardware pressure limits and compliant dynamics remain separate control requirements.
constraints.zh: 离线手指分配在执行期间固定；接触目标修正有幅值边界。硬件气压限制和柔顺动力学仍属独立控制要求。

training.en: VR force-labeled trajectories are retargeted and used to train a diffusion policy. A learned pressure-to-displacement model is optimized at execution for low-level tracking.
training.zh: VR力标注轨迹经重定向后训练扩散策略；执行时对学习的气压到位移模型进行优化，实现底层跟踪。

protocol.zh: 六项虚拟操作任务；分别测试单指平面跟踪、仿真物体轨迹误差和真机任务成功。 软指控制器测试：4种平面图形，各40航点、3圈；动捕提供实测指尖位置。真机策略使用标记跟踪的物体位姿。 控制器：直接KNN、直接MLP、线性模型。重定向：纯运动学、仅第二阶段消融与完整SoftAct。
protocol.en: Six virtual manipulation tasks. Separate single-finger planar tracking, simulated object-motion error and real task-success evaluations. Soft-finger controller test: four planar shapes, 40 waypoints each, three loops; motion capture supplies measured fingertip positions. Real policy uses marker-tracked object poses. Controller: direct KNN, direct MLP, linear model. Retargeting: kinematic and stage-2-only ablation versus full SoftAct.

limits.zh: 虚拟力标签来自仿真，不是实测人类力GT。55% RMSE下降属于单指控制，不是完整任务成功率增幅；基于视觉的sim-to-real仍列为未来工作。 并非无标记纯相机协议；带标记动捕和虚拟交互是核心输入。
limits.en: Virtual force labels come from simulation, not physical human-force GT. The reported 55% RMSE reduction is single-finger control, not full-task success gain. Vision-based sim-to-real is future work. No unmarked camera-only protocol; marked motion capture and virtual interactions are central.

description.en: Train across many reference motions rather than restarting a separate policy for every demonstration.
description.zh: 跨多条参考动作训练，而非每条示范重新训练一套策略。

input.en: Hand-object references, robot state, current/reference object point clouds, SDF features and future motion encoding.
input.zh: 手物参考、机器人状态、当前/参考物体点云、SDF特征与未来动作编码。

output.en: Left/right actor-critic pairs shared across references; successful simulated rollouts are saved as robot trajectories.
output.zh: 左右手actor-critic分别跨参考共享参数；成功仿真rollout保存为机器人轨迹。

objective.en: FlashSAC with geometric object alignment, reference fingertip proximity, hand tracking and regularization.
objective.zh: FlashSAC结合物体几何对齐、参考指尖接近关系、手部跟踪和正则。

constraints.en: Physics simulation and tracking rewards shape behavior; thresholds determine whether a stored rollout counts. A successful demonstration conversion is not a formal robustness guarantee.
constraints.zh: 通过物理仿真和跟踪奖励塑造行为，以阈值判定保存的rollout是否成功。示范转换成功不是形式化鲁棒性保证。

training.en: Multi-reference off-policy FlashSAC. Left/right actor-critic pairs share parameters across reference motions; total GPU-hours and all failure costs must accompany conversion results.
training.zh: 使用多参考离策略FlashSAC；左右手actor-critic分别跨参考共享参数。转换结果必须同时报告总GPU小时和失败成本。

protocol.zh: TACO、OakInk2、HOT3D；主集25条单物体加25条双物体动作，目标XHand和Sharpa；扩展到200/500/1000条参考。 RTX3090 / Isaac Sim。SR_MT-Obj使用物体3 cm和30°阈值；SR_MT还加手部阈值。SR_SPIDER对活跃物体误差取平均，阈值10 cm与0.5 rad。 Do As I Do、公开PPO版CHORD，以及改为随机参考状态初始化的DexMachina。单参考计算量包括失败尝试。
protocol.en: TACO, OakInk2, HOT3D; main set has 25 single-object +25 two-object motions, XHand and Sharpa. Scaling uses 200/500/1,000 references. RTX3090 / Isaac Sim. SR_MT-Obj: object 3 cm and 30°; SR_MT adds hand thresholds. SR_SPIDER uses averaged active-object errors of 10 cm and 0.5 rad. Do As I Do, released PPO CHORD, and DexMachina adapted to random reference-state initialization. Compute includes failed single-reference attempts.

limits.zh: XHand的90%是SR_SPIDER；更严的SR_MT-Obj/SR_MT为86%，耗时29 GPU小时。累计转换只需存到一次成功，不等于每次执行可靠性或未见动作泛化。真机回放展示3项任务，未给出通用成功率。 不是在线纯相机遥操器；需要源重建与可用于仿真的几何。
limits.en: XHand 90% is SR_SPIDER; stricter SR_MT-Obj/SR_MT are 86%, at 29 GPU-hours. Cumulative conversion counts a stored success once, not per-rollout reliability or unseen-motion generalization. Real replay demonstrates three tasks without a general success-rate claim. Not an online camera teleoperator; source reconstruction and simulation-ready geometry are prerequisites.

description.zh: 从互联网抓握图像提取姿态先验，帮助强化学习探索有效抓法。属于抓取策略学习。
description.en: Internet grasp images supply pose priors for reinforcement learning, rather than continuous teleoperation.

input.zh: 人手图像先验；策略观察 RGB-D、可供性图与本体状态。
input.en: Human-image priors; policy observations include RGB-D, affordances and proprioception.

output.zh: Adroit 的 30 维动作，包含手与臂。
output.en: Thirty-dimensional Adroit hand–arm actions.

objective.zh: 抬起奖励、可供性区域接触、姿态相似性与熵。
objective.en: Lift, affordance-contact, pose-similarity and entropy rewards.

constraints.zh: 姿态奖励只在触觉传感器达到指定接触比例后启用。
constraints.en: Pose rewards activate after a specified touch-sensor threshold.

training.zh: FrankMocap 估计姿态，经聚类和 IK 形成先验，再训练 PPO。
training.en: FrankMocap estimates, clustering and IK produce priors for PPO training.

protocol.zh: 27 个物体、MuJoCo；每物体 100 次评测、4 个训练 seeds。基线包含 CoM、Touch、GRAFF 与 DAPG。
protocol.en: MuJoCo: 27 objects, 100 trials per object, four seeds. Baselines: CoM, Touch, GRAFF and DAPG.

limits.zh: 全部实验为仿真；非连续人手机器人动作映射，不能当成几何重定向 baseline。
limits.en: Simulation-only evidence; not a continuous human-to-robot mapper or interchangeable geometric baseline.

title.zh: 人手姿态 / 人体动作

text.zh: 它描述源人手的姿态与运动。光学标记、多视角重建或拟合 MANO 的误差与遮挡各不相同。即使源姿态完全准确，也没有因此获得不同机器人唯一正确的关节答案。
text.en: This describes the source human motion. Markers, multiview reconstruction and fitted MANO have different errors and occlusions. Even exact human motion does not define a unique correct robot configuration.

text.zh: 人工锚点、同步遥操或优化器伪标签都能提供对应，但它们包含人的选择或目标函数偏好。AnyDexRT 使用稀疏锚点；GeoRT 无密集配对标签，也仍需要人体与机器人活动空间数据。
text.en: Manual anchors, synchronized teleoperation and optimizer pseudo-labels provide correspondence, each containing human or objective preferences. AnyDexRT uses sparse anchors; GeoRT avoids dense pairs but still requires human and robot workspace data.

text.zh: 网格距离阈值、表面接触标注、仿真碰撞标签与真实触觉不是同一种 GT。几何上靠近只说明距离小；它不直接给出法向力、摩擦力或是否已经稳定承载。
text.en: Mesh-distance thresholds, surface annotations, simulated collision labels and tactile measurements are different forms of evidence. Geometric proximity gives a small distance, not normal force, friction force or stable load-bearing.

text.zh: 物体标记或估计位姿提供目标轨迹；模拟轨迹只是给定质量、摩擦、控制器与步长下的结果。接触、抬起、保持、移动、放置与完整任务应分别定义，不能用“像”替代“做成”。
text.en: Object tracking supplies a reference trajectory. A simulated trajectory is conditional on mass, friction, controller and timestep. Define contact, lift, hold, transport, placement and full-task success separately; resemblance is not completion.

evidence.zh: 论文与代码解读；未独立复现论文实验。互动数值只来自页面显示的教学模型。
evidence.en: Paper and code analysis; no independent reproduction of paper experiments. Interactive values come only from the displayed teaching models.
